expanders.title: What I'm building
paragraphs: One place my life and projects run on, readable by a person and by agents. Markdown in git is the source of truth; any index can be rebuilt from it. Nothing leaves except through a public folder, and only a publish gate puts anything there.

expanders.title: What I tried
paragraphs: A separate brain per domain, each with its own root, so a tool that reads one cannot wander into another. A sealed vault the learning tools are barred from by their path rules. In the business brain, two blind scoring passes checked the rubric before I trusted it.

expanders.title: What didn't work
paragraphs: The learning map reads one root, and that root is a sibling brain, so notes written here don't show up on it yet. The first business-brain rubric failed its agreement test on three criteria; rewritten as decision rules, all passed. Plaid was too much for the finance brain.

expanders.title: Open questions and next
paragraphs: Whether the brains merge or stay separate is not decided. The finance brain is trying a different way to bring data in.
